final_decision.rationale: block_boundary=1.326 (>1.1, 0%FP) mandates JPEG. Spectral slope ratio=0.995 and FFT anisotropy=0 rule out blur (blur control R21 broke noise/bb checks). Peeled residual (JPEG removed, std=20.4) is dominated by low-frequency structured difference: variance_ratio=0.843, mean_shift=-6.9, residual_intensity_corr=0.48 indicate multiplicative noise; §B gives vm_slope=0.51 (multiplicative), var_slope=-0.03 (not Poisson), rgb_ratio=1.05 (not YCrCb), extreme_pct=62.8% is JPEG-ringing FP. Speckle:3+JPEG:2 reproduces mean_shift (R13 global:mean_shift MATCH), and its variance_ratio (0.848 derived by removing the 0.75^2 contrast factor from R13 sim vr 0.477) matches target 0.843, so no global step. Candidate verified MATCH (noise:sigma, noise:clean_residual FWHM, compression:block_boundary) on all 5 support pairs. Noise step can never be LIKELY (seed mismatch); JPEG is signal-verified on 5/5 pairs but PSNR>=40dB confirmation impossible under noise, hence UNCERTAIN. Severity residual ambiguity: speckle:2+jpeg:1 also passes checks (kept as alternative).

reanalysis: Overlooked signal #1 (tone shoulder): binned median/mean of (target-clean) in FLAT regions (3x3 local sd<2) shows identity below clean~150 and a monotone asymmetric highlight roll-off above: -3.8 @192, -12.3 @222, -25.1 @248, -28.6 @254 (pairs 0/1/4 consistent). No global x_distortion function can produce a highlight-only shoulder (brightness_darken_shift: constant -25.5 at all levels; brightness_darken_gamma_RGB 1.4: -38 at midtone; contrast_weaken_scale 0.75: symmetric about image mean; saturation: chroma only; quantization_median/hist: excluded by unique_G=256).

Overlooked signal #2 (dct_zero_ratio): target 0.5587 vs compression_jpeg:2-on-clean 0.7278 (diff 0.169) vs noise_speckle:3+compression_jpeg:2 0.5588 (diff 0.0001) on pair0; per-pair control diff 0.0005-0.0035. Pre-JPEG noise fills DCT coefficients, so this signal both proves noise precedes JPEG and pins the JPEG severity. R0 recorded but did not use this signal (verify_signals stores it without adding to matches).

Misjudged signal #3 (step2 GAUSSIAN_YCrCb): raw verdict is a JPEG/gamma-suspect FP. cross_channel_corr 0.79-0.94 arises from JPEG YCbCr processing plus shared clipping; residual_intensity_corr 0.25-0.57 is corr(|residual|, intensity), which is exactly zero-mean multiplicative noise's magnitude relation plus the clip shoulder (signed speckle residual is uncorrelated with intensity). all 5 pairs set gamma_suspect_from_noise=True yet no deterministic tone function fits the measured curve.

Boundary signal #4 (extreme_pct): peeled extreme_pct 62.8-64.8% with zero_ratio only 0.072 is the 'residual<=0' convention FP: residual=target-simulated and mean_shift=-7 makes ~half of all pixels count as extreme. Not salt&pepper; SKILL FP rule applies.

Boundary signal #5 (saturation): pair4 full_analysis flags SATURATION_strengthen_sev4 (chroma_ratio 1.2423) while pairs 0-3 give 0.890-0.981 -> content-dependent JPEG/noise chroma interaction, not a consistent step. Adding any global step would break the already exact mean_shift/variance_ratio fingerprint.
Blur re-check: spectral_slope_ratio 0.969-0.995 (<1.08), FFT anisotropy 0, radial/pca 0; R0 blur control broke sigma (80%) and bb (14%). No blur.
